rows.en: Clovis: "It's open."
Yamato: '...I'll hide, then.'
Touya: 'Oh, right. Sorry about that.'
Yamato: 'It's fine. See you.'
Clovis: "Hey. What's up?"
Touya: "There's something I want to ask..."
Clovis: "Sure. What is it? How to woo women?"
Touya: "...Don't lump me in with you.
It's about Aurelie."
Clovis: "What, how to woo Aurelie?
Now that's a tricky question."
Touya: "Is that all you ever think about?!"
Clovis: "Calm down. It's about what happened before, right?"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Clovis: "Have you asked her yet?"
Touya: "Yeah. She said it was her problem and wouldn't answer.
I heard you cheered her up when she was down.
Hey, could it be that she... You know, you..."
Clovis: "...Touya. How do you
feel about her?"
Touya: "Huh? How do I...?"
Clovis: "If you're just worried, stop getting involved with her.
If it's more than that, I'll answer you."
Touya: "?"
Clovis: "...Are you worried about her as a comrade,
or as a woman? Which is it?"
Touya: "Huh?! W-Well..."
Clovis: "..."
Well, as a comrade...
Of course I'm worried about her as more than a comrade.
Clovis: "...Do you really mean that?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Clovis: "..."
Touya: "..."
...The truth is, I see her as more than a comrade.
Clovis: "...I see. All right."
Touya: "But I'm still worried about her..."
Clovis: "That isn't the point.
Sorry. Just forget it."
Yamato: "...We didn't find out after all..."
Touya: "..."
Clovis: "I see...
All right. I'll tell you. To start with, she and I
are no more than comrades.
But she's developed feelings for a man like me.
And I've always pretended not to notice."
Touya: "...Why?"
Clovis: "I have no right to accept her feelings.
Not when I couldn't protect the person I loved."
Touya: "The person you loved?"
Clovis: "My wife..."
Touya: "What?! You were married?!"
Clovis: "Yes."
Touya: "I see... Then that'd be an affair... Huh?
But you couldn't protect her... Did she die?"
Clovis: "...Yes."
Touya: "...I-I'm sorry..."
Clovis: "...Don't worry about it.
To only realize how much she meant to me after she died...
I'm a complete fool..."
Touya: "...It wasn't that you didn't love her, was it?"
Clovis: "...My wife, Elena, was my superior's daughter when I was in the military.
Being the top ace had become something everyone expected of me.
The pressure drove me to rely on the power of Elena's father.
That's how rotten I'd become.
To secure my own position,
I used her."
Touya: "..."
Clovis: "And she loved a man like that.
But at the time, it only caused me pain.
The guilt of using Elena, and feeling bound to her
to protect my position.
Outwardly, I played the good husband.
...I was the lowest of the low."
Touya: "Don't tell me your wife died because..."
Clovis: "No. It was a traffic accident. At the time, she said it wasn't
serious and didn't even go to the hospital. But apparently she'd hit her head,
and she suddenly collapsed..."
Touya: "...And that was it?"
Clovis: "She regained consciousness once. Then,
she smiled at me and said...
'You're free.'
Even in that state, instead of herself,
she was worrying about me.
Elena held my hand through her fading consciousness. Her last
words were 'I love you'...
It shook me. I regretted it.
She'd understood everything, yet she still told me
she loved a man like me."
Touya: "..."
Clovis: "Neither our relatives nor our friends blamed me.
They offered words of encouragement instead.
I couldn't bear it.
So I left the military and turned my back on reality.
I used despair as an excuse and ran away."
Touya: "But looking at you now, I'd never have imagined
any of that..."
Clovis: "Now, I'm practically living a lie to myself.
Fighting keeps me from losing sight of who I am.
Someone like that has no right to love anyone."
Touya: "So that's why you can't return Aurelie's feelings...
...Why did you tell me all that?"
Clovis: "Heh... I wonder why.
Maybe I'm losing my edge."
Touya: "Hey... Is that a dig at me?"
Clovis: "Hahaha. I'm joking.
...But I can't keep running forever.
It may be time to talk things through with Aurelie."
Touya: "...But Aurelie feels that way about you..."
Clovis: "She isn't used to being loved either.
She's just mistaking kindness and admiration for love.
Besides, I don't think I can love anyone right now.
That's not running away. It's how I really feel.
If I accept her feelings when I'm like this,
I'll only hurt her. I've had enough of making
other people sad."
Touya: "Will she be all right if you do that?
She acts tough, but..."
Clovis: "That's why I'm telling you.
You're probably the first person she's told about herself.
She doesn't realize it, but that proves she trusts you.
So I want you to be there for her."
Touya: "Me...?"
Clovis: "Were you lying just now?"
Touya: "...No. You're right.
I don't know how much I can do, but..."
Clovis: "You can do it."
Touya: "You sound more sure than I am."
Clovis: "I like to think I'm a good judge of character."
Touya: "..."
Clovis: "..."
Touya: "...All right."
Clovis: "Good! That's the man I put my faith in!"
Touya: "But... Encouraging her seems to have the opposite effect,
and I don't think I can do what you did
before... What should I do?"
Clovis: "Figure that out for yourself.
What do you have that head for?"
Touya: "That's so irresponsible..."
Clovis: "Well, that's how it is. I'm counting on you."
Touya: "H-Hey... Honestly..."
Yamato: "...This has turned into quite a situation."
Touya: "Yeah..."
